messages:
sarah_cs: Heads up — Meridian renewal (Dedicated capacity). CFO wants Net60, procurement insists on PO + vendor code, and legal is asking for a KMS/HSM clause for their Private deployment. Can we confirm sign flow + timeline?

ben_legal: I can take legal review. Need to know which KMS they use (cloud-KMS vs on-prem HSM) and the exact authorized signer names for PO delegation.

anya: I have procurement contact (Connor). He prefers PO. I asked him for vendor code and delegation docs. Connor@meridian.com\. cc @mike for vendor onboarding.

mike: I can start vendor code request but need billing entity + tax id. Sarah — can you drop the entity mapping here or DM?

sarah_cs: DMing entity/tax now. Timeline: they asked to close by EOD Friday. Can Ops/legal make that? :grimacing: 

ben_legal: EOD Fri is aggressive but possible if we get delegation docs today. For the KMS clause I need: (1) KMS provider name, (2) whether keys are customer-managed, (3) any export controls. If they require HSM attestation, that's a longer loop.

karen_ops: For the PO path finance prefers 9mo term at a discount. Procurement already signaled they'd accept 9 months. Pricing change needs manager approval though. @anya pls confirm what they verbally agreed to.

anya: Confirmed verbally: Meridian will accept 9mo term at 10% off list in exchange for Net60. Putting that on record here so pricing/ legal can align.

sarah_cs: Great — so propose 9mo / 10% / Net60. Ben — what delegation proof do you accept if CFO can't physically sign?

ben_legal: Acceptable: (A) signed board resolution, (B) an email from CFO from corporate domain naming the authorized sig, or (C) a scanned wet-signature + title page. If using DocuSign, ensure the signer email matches the delegation email exactly.

mike: Heads-up: Meridian's DocuSign SSO is flaky (they reported SAML errors). If DocuSign fails, fallback is wet-sign PDF. Ops can upload executed PDFs to SFDC.

anya: Connor just replied — vendor_code MER-2026 and PO# PO-9812. He's sending a scanned delegation email from the CFO now.

sarah_cs: Sharing PO snippet they gave (sanitized):
```
PO#: PO-9812
Vendor code: MER-2026
Billing entity: Meridian Corp EU
Tax ID: EU123456789
Term: 9 months
Net: 60 days
```

karen_ops: Do not post wire or bank info in public channel. I'll DM payments@redwood.com to coordinate wire instructions and confirm receivable details.

ben_legal: Received the delegation email PDF from Connor. I'll slot the KMS clause into the SOW and send redlines by EOD. If DocuSign works we can capture signers; if not, proceed with wet-sign + upload.

sarah_cs: Plan: I will open a DocuSign envelope with the 9mo/10%/Net60 terms + KMS clause placeholder and tag Ben for review. If DocuSign fails due to SSO we'll switch to wet-sign. Target: signed by Friday 17:00 PT. Thanks everyone :party_parrot: 

mike: Noted — I'll create vendor onboarding ticket once I have billing entity confirmation and attach PO#.

anya: I'll follow up with Connor to push the CFO email through and confirm signer name. Will update thread.

sarah_cs: Thanks all — please ping here if you see any blocker.
